title: Hundredth monkey effect on Japanese islands

tellings.quote: island of monkeys certain type of monkey I think it's in Japan that they have a species of monkeys that's separated by an island

plain: Randy Anderson, a guest who says he saw alien technology at a military base, brings up what is known as the hundredth monkey effect, the idea that once enough members of a group learn something, others who were never taught seem to pick it up too. He places it, a little unsure, on islands in Japan, where he says a species of monkey lives split up by water. He uses it to suggest knowledge might pass between minds without contact.
